title: Tarbiyat — Topological Bildung: A First-Principles Metatheory of Human Capability, Education, and Development
description: A collection of twenty-two high-density posters developing Topological Bildung — education as the progressive calibration of an individual's internal state-space to match the multi-scale reality of the physical and informational world. Spans a lifelong developmental pipeline, stream guidance without gatekeeping, universal generics of rigor and endurance, a somatic anchor of elite athletics and traditional meditation, training for failure and detached mastery, and strict clinical boundaries separating deep cognitive focus from pathology. Companion to The Geometry of Becoming.
